title: 一阶有源低通滤波器
statement: 反相放大器的反馈电阻 R_f 两端并联了电容 C_f。R₁ = 10 kΩ，R_f = 20 kΩ，C_f = 0.05 µF，运放是理想运放。网络函数 H(jω) = V̇_o/V̇_s。
求 ω = 1000 rad/s 时的 20lg|H(jω)| 和 H(jω) 的相位。再求这个电路的通带增益和截止频率 f_c。

questions.ask: 通带增益（ω = 1 rad/s 时的 H，取实部）= ?
questions.explain: 通带（直流）增益：在很低的频率 ω = 1 rad/s 下，C_f 相当于开路，H ≈ −R_f/R₁ = −2（6.02 dB）。ω → ∞ 时 C_f 把输出短接到虚地，H → 0，所以是低通。
|H| 降到 2/√2（比通带低 3 dB）的频率由 ωR_fC_f = 1 决定：ω_c = 1/(R_fC_f) = 1000 rad/s，f_c ≈ 159.2 Hz——本题的 ω 正好是截止频率。

hints: 反相放大器的公式对阻抗同样成立：H = −Z_f/Z₁，这里 Z_f = R_f ∥ (1/jωC_f)。
solution: **1. 网络函数。** 反相端虚地，İ₁ = V̇_s/R₁ 全部流过反馈阻抗 Z_f = R_f/(1 + jωR_fC_f)：H(jω) = −Z_f/R₁ = −(R_f/R₁)·1/(1 + jω/ω_c)，ω_c = 1/(R_fC_f) = 1/(2×10⁴ × 5×10⁻⁸) = 1000 rad/s。
**2. 特性。** 直流增益 −R_f/R₁ = −2（6.02 dB），高频增益 → 0：一阶**有源低通**。
**4. 有源的好处。** 输出由运放驱动，接负载不会改变 H。对比第 5 题：无源 RC 接上负载后，增益和截止频率都变了。而且有源电路的通带增益可以大于 1。

en.title: First-order active low-pass filter
statement: An inverting amplifier has a capacitor C_f in parallel with its feedback resistor R_f. R₁ = 10 kΩ, R_f = 20 kΩ, C_f = 0.05 µF, and the op-amp is ideal. The network function is H(jω) = V̇_o/V̇_s.
Find 20lg|H(jω)| and the phase of H(jω) at ω = 1000 rad/s. Then find the pass-band gain and the cut-off frequency f_c of this circuit.

questions.explain: H = −2/(1 + j) = −1 + j: the inversion gives 180°, the RC gives −45°, 135° in total (or −225°).

questions.ask: Pass-band gain (H at ω = 1 rad/s, real part) = ?
questions.explain: Pass-band (DC) gain: at a very low frequency, ω = 1 rad/s, C_f is practically open and H ≈ −R_f/R₁ = −2 (6.02 dB). As ω → ∞, C_f shorts the output to the virtual ground and H → 0, so this is a low-pass filter.
|H| drops to 2/√2 (3 dB below the pass band) where ωR_fC_f = 1: ω_c = 1/(R_fC_f) = 1000 rad/s, f_c ≈ 159.2 Hz — the ω in this problem is exactly the cut-off.

hints: The inverting-amplifier formula also works with impedances: H = −Z_f/Z₁, here with Z_f = R_f ∥ (1/jωC_f).
Z_f = R_f/(1 + jωR_fC_f); work out ωR_fC_f first.
solution: **1. Network function.** The inverting input is a virtual ground, so İ₁ = V̇_s/R₁ flows entirely through the feedback impedance Z_f = R_f/(1 + jωR_fC_f): H(jω) = −Z_f/R₁ = −(R_f/R₁)·1/(1 + jω/ω_c), with ω_c = 1/(R_fC_f) = 1/(2×10⁴ × 5×10⁻⁸) = 1000 rad/s.
**2. Behaviour.** DC gain −R_f/R₁ = −2 (6.02 dB), high-frequency gain → 0: a first-order **active low-pass**.

**4. Why active.** The op-amp drives the output, so a load doesn't change H. Compare problem 5: loading a passive RC changed both its gain and its cut-off. And the pass-band gain of an active circuit can exceed 1.
